description: This file implements the MainThread class and related factory functions for managing a dedicated main thread, including client registration, task queuing, and thread loop management within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: MainThread
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread executing queued tasks, handles client registration, and maintains thread lifecycle.

classes.name: MainThread::TaskInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a queued task, including client ID, task function, synchronization primitives.

methods.name: MainThread::MainThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the main thread, starts the thread loop, and registers the main client.

methods.name: MainThread::~MainThread
methods.description: Destructor that signals thread shutdown, enqueues shutdown task, and joins the thread.

methods.name: MainThread::mainThreadLoop
methods.description: Main loop running in the thread, processing tasks from the queue while the thread is active.

methods.name: MainThread::waitForTask
methods.description: Waits for and retrieves the next task from the task queue.

methods.name: MainThread::registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client, assigns a client ID, and enqueues registration task.

methods.name: MainThread::unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client by removing its ID from the registered clients set.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task for a specific client ID into the task queue.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Enqueues a task and waits for its completion using condition variables.
